consoleWarnings.text: The powerPreference option is currently ignored when calling requestAdapter() on Windows. See https://crbug.com/369219127

classification.powerPreference: Exact browser Windows GPU capability notice; source URL empty, so YouTube attribution is contextual only.
classification.adapter: GPU adapter warning directly attributed to the loaded YouTube embed.

recommendation: No application change. Preserve strict first-party warnings. Before accepting adapter warning as harmless, a focused one-page diagnostic should prove that this exact loaded embed can start media despite the warning. Do not suppress arbitrary source-less warnings or all YouTube warnings.
